description: Two Marconato machines (Type II governor / fixed torque, AVRSimple) on a fully dynamic 60 Hz network; P_ref step; PSID reference plus the PSCAD Test25 voltage trajectory.
skip_eigenvalues: the PSID reference runs in its ReferenceBus frame (its constant-frequency frame fails to initialize with all lines dynamic), a different linearization from the hermess nominal frame; the invariant trajectories and the PSCAD comparison carry this case

pscad.upstream_acceptance: PSID-vs-PSCAD 2-norm <= 0.1 on v102 (relaxed upstream to account for mismatch in damping)

achieved_2026_08.note: SG1:xg is excluded from the trajectory comparison: PSID realizes the lead-lag with the feedthrough separated (its state settles at (1 - T1/T2) times ours); the input/output behavior is identical, as the omega agreement shows
